developer.comment: Single-maintainer open-source project; no company behind it. GitHub handle moona3k is the only identity published.

first-release.comment: Changelog lists 'MacParakeet Launch · v0.1' in February 2026 (project initialized January 2026).

status.comment: Actively developed; v0.7.x releases shipping through mid-2026 (checked 2026-07-29).

license.comment: GPL-3.0 since 2026-03-25. Previously a $49 one-time proprietary purchase; there is no paid or feature-limited edition now.

primary-type.comment: Genuinely all three: system-wide hotkey dictation, file/URL transcription, and local meeting recording with live notes and optional summaries.

website.comment: Official product site; source at https://github.com/moona3k/macparakeet.

real-time-dictation.comment: Hotkey (Fn by default) push-to-talk or double-tap persistent dictation; text is inserted at the cursor in the focused app.

file-transcription.comment: Drag audio/video files or folders; also media URLs (YouTube, podcasts, ~1000 yt-dlp-supported sites).

live-meeting-capture.comment: Records microphone plus system audio via ScreenCaptureKit with a live local transcript — no bot joins the call.

streaming-low-latency.comment: Live transcript preview during meeting recording and near-instant dictation output; Parakeet v3 runs ~155x realtime on the Neural Engine (vendor figure). Cohere Transcribe is batch-only with no live preview.

audio-sources.comment: No meeting bot — conference audio is captured at the OS level instead of joining calls as a participant.

underlying-engine.value: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT v3 on the Apple Neural Engine (FluidAudio CoreML); optional WhisperKit, Nemotron, Cohere Transcribe
underlying-engine.comment: Engines are user-selectable and can be pinned separately for dictation vs file/meeting work; all run locally.

language-count.comment: Approx. 98 languages total, but only after downloading WhisperKit models. The default Parakeet v3 engine covers English plus 25 European languages; CJK/Korean route to WhisperKit or Cohere.

english-accuracy.comment: No independent test of the app itself; rating anchored to its default engine. The Open ASR Leaderboard paper reports Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 at 6.32% average English WER (v2: 6.05%) — near the top of the leaderboard but a step behind the very best on accuracy. Vendor claims ~2.5% WER, which is not independently corroborated.

multilingual-auto-detect.comment: Parakeet v3 auto-detects among its 25 supported European languages; WhisperKit offers explicit language choice or auto-detect.

custom-vocabulary.comment: User-managed custom words with case-insensitive replacement, filler removal and snippet expansion; vocabulary is exportable/importable as versioned JSON.

speaker-diarization.comment: Automatic diarization with stable speaker IDs, optional manual renaming, and per-speaker talk-time/word stats. Availability depends on the selected engine.

timestamps.comment: Word-level timestamps with Parakeet, Nemotron and WhisperKit; not available with the Cohere Transcribe engine.

ai-summaries-notes.comment: Summaries, chat/Ask, formatting and Transforms exist but are entirely opt-in and require the user to configure an LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, or local Ollama/LM Studio). Nothing is summarised by default.

built-in-editor.comment: Indeterminate: the app has a transcript library, a meeting notes editor and manual speaker renaming, but no documented in-app transcript text-correction editor — docs emphasise reviewing and exporting to external tools. Not confirmed either way as of 2026-07-29.

translation.comment: No documented translation feature — the 98-language claim is multilingual transcription, not translation. A user could ad-hoc translate a transcript via the optional LLM prompt/Transform features, but that is not a shipped translation function.

export-formats.comment: Also exports DAPT XML for localization workflows, which has no tag in this comparison. JSON export includes word-level confidence scores.

processing-location.comment: All speech recognition runs locally on Apple Silicon; audio never leaves the Mac and no cloud STT is involved. Only the opt-in AI text features send transcript text to a provider the user configures (which can also be local).

offline-capable.comment: Fully usable offline once the model is downloaded; no account or sign-in required. Network is needed only for model/app downloads, URL imports and optional cloud LLM features.

data-used-for-training.comment: Privacy policy states nothing is sent to servers and telemetry explicitly excludes audio, transcripts and personal identifiers (anonymous usage stats only, opt-out in Settings). The vendor therefore never receives data to train on; if a user enables cloud AI features, that provider's own policy applies.

data-deletion-control.comment: Everything is stored locally; library supports multi-select bulk deletion, Private Dictation Mode disables history, and removing the app deletes all data.

platforms.comment: Apple Silicon Macs only (M1 or newer), macOS 14.2+. Intel Macs are unsupported because the Parakeet model requires the Neural Engine.

system-wide-dictation.comment: Global hotkey inserts text into any focused app (Slack, VS Code, Gmail, Notes); the overlay does not steal focus.

integrations.comment: No service-level integrations or sign-ins. It works with Zoom/Meet/Teams/Slack huddles only by capturing system audio at the OS level, and meeting reminders/auto-start read the local macOS Calendar via EventKit rather than connecting to Google or Microsoft accounts.

api-automation.comment: Public `macparakeet-cli` covers dictation, file/folder/URL transcription, vocabulary and engine selection; repo also documents agent integration (AGENTS.md) and OpenAI-compatible provider hooks.

pricing-model.comment: Free and GPL-3.0 since 2026-03-25; no subscription, no paid tier, no account required (checked 2026-07-29).

free-tier.comment: The whole app is free — there is no stripped-down 'community edition'.

free-allowance.comment: Only practical costs are an Apple Silicon Mac and, optionally, the user's own LLM API spend for the opt-in AI features.

entry-price-usd-mo.comment: No subscription exists — the tool is free/open source. It was previously sold as a $49 one-time purchase before going GPL-3.0 on 2026-03-25.
